title: Modularize CloudTrail -> OpenSearch audit pipeline with pluggable retention/migration
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Replace the current monolithic audit tfmodule with a modular Terraform implementation that separates CloudTrail collection, S3 archival, OpenSearch ingestion, and retention lifecycle so teams can opt into different retention tiers, run schema-safe retention migrations, and perform non-disruptive upgrades in Private/VPC deployments. Deliverables: 1) new terraform module 'redwood/audit-pipeline' with submodules: cloudtrail, s3-archive, opensearch-ingest, ilm-policies, kms-integrations; 2) migration helpers for changing retention from hot->warm->cold and for moving archived objects to Glacier/Glacier Deep Archive with lifecycle hooks; 3) automated health checks (synthetic events, ingest latency SLO, index retention validation) and remediation runbook; 4) upgrade playbook and canary plan for on-prem and cross-account trails.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Module published to internal registry with stable interface; 2) Existing terraform stacks can switch to new module with a short feature-flagged rollout; 3) Retention policy updates execute without loss of CloudTrail events and with verified index ILM transitions; 4) Health checks surface retention drift and send alerts to PagerDuty; 5) Automated e2e test validates S3 lifecycle transitions and OpenSearch index deletion after retention expiry.
decision_notes:
- Choose S3 lifecycle + CloudTrail multi-region trails as single source-of-truth for raw events; ingest pipeline will be eventually consistent.
- Use OpenSearch ILM for index lifecycle, but make retention policy templated and versioned to support hot/warm/cold tiers.
- KMS key rotation: integrate with customer-managed KMS but default to Redwood-managed key for self-hosted quickstart.
- Migration path will snapshot index metadata and use TTL delete for safe cleanup to avoid accidental data loss.
tradeoffs:
- Stronger isolation (per-customer indices) increases index count and cluster mgmt overhead; mitigated by configurable index-rollover cadence.
- Using lifecycle hooks that transition to Glacier increases restore latency for forensic requests; provide explicit rehydration playbook.
- Backwards compatibility requires extra tfstate steps for older stacks; added migration helper scripts to minimize manual steps.
implementation_notes:
- Terraform 1.6 native modules with registry style outputs and inputs; avoid provider alias proliferation.
- Write acceptance tests using Terratest and a small ephemeral AWS account to validate S3 lifecycle rules and CloudTrail delivery.
- OpenSearch ILM policies generated from templates in module (json rendered via templatefile()).
- Add a 'migration' resource that creates a lockfile in S3 to coordinate in-place retention changes.
- Provide a Skaffold-like canary: route 5% of trails to new pipeline then validate before full cutover.
risks:
- Risk of index misconfiguration causing premature deletion. Mitigation: preflight dry-run that simulates ILM transitions against test indices.
- Cross-account permissions complexity for partners: document minimal IAM needed and provide 'bootstrap' playbooks.
- Cost spike during migration while retaining both old and new copies: include cost-warning in Console rollout and recommend off-peak migration windows.
